Did Ginny Weasley secretly become the true master of Harry Potter’s wand?

It sounds impossible… but when you take a closer look at how wand allegiance actually works in the wizarding world, there’s a shocking stretch of the series where Harry may not have been the master of his own wand at all.

From Draco Malfoy disarming Dumbledore, to the chaos at Malfoy Manor, to a very overlooked moment in Order of the Phoenix… this theory connects the dots in a way that completely changes how you view Harry’s magic.

And if it’s true… Ginny may have been the true master of Harry’s wand for nearly an entire book. Let’s dive in.
